changes: Add V-R-V3N0M as a fourth theme, inspired by the supplied liquid code; retain the system cursor.
Both KDE and XFCE are first-release targets; 2–4 GB/VM hardware is the primary design target.
Keyboard and mouse are equally supported; restrained glass with a dense layout and Android-style control center.
Independent concurrent tendrils preserve A hold while B seeks/holds; budgets are explicit, performance unverified.
Wi-Fi inspection/profile editing/passphrase flow is requested. Preview is demo-only; native system authorization must use polkit/secret-agent APIs.
The user explicitly requested HTML as a reference. Browser work is not acceptance evidence for Linux packs.
Native panels vs eww/Conky architecture has been proposed, not formally reconciled with the PRD renderer contract.
Palette/token duplication, exact original geometry, full global hotkeys and blanket two-click action policy need reconciliation; do not silently drop requirements.
priorities: P0: Freeze contracts; connect one palette/token source; implement generator and colour/contrast/determinism checks.
P0: Complete exact dry-run plans, baseline snapshots and install→reinstall→rollback→uninstall tests before asking for a real install.

P1: Implement ttoxd/schema/providers/user units, then real network/privileged actions and complete System/Network/Dev/Kali HUD coverage.
P1: Complete widget folder contract, S/M/L, edit/gallery/grid persistence, four profiles and Conky fallback; restore every required hotkey and tmux drawer.
